fields.title: Find implicit promises
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: What can become a commitment here and how to restrict it in advance?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Order list is returned sorted by date
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Webhook arrives in 1.2 seconds on average
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: On error, the response body contains a `message` field with text
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — if sorting is not declared but stable, clients will rely on it; either guarantee it explicitly or do not return a stable order from the start. 2 — parsing the identifier structure; declare it opaque and do not promise the format. 3 — timing will become an expectation; explicitly state that delivery time is not guaranteed. 4 — code will start parsing the text; provide sufficiently detailed error codes so this isn't needed, and declare the text mutable.
